summary_zh: 修复后：Duet 三个声部都落在小音箱放得出的音区（低音最低 E2 = MIDI 40，次中音 >= 48，中音 >= 53；修复前男声输入时低音低到 MIDI 16，即 21 Hz），并按她实测的音高(f0)逐段检查、修掉平行五八度。40 位真人歌手端到端、拿她标注的真实音符算：不冲突 96.0%（修复前 96.0%），平行五度/八度 0/0（修复前 6/1）；巴赫测试集仍是 100% 不冲突、0 平行。不足：仍靠音高闸门临时静音（Duet 静音约占她演唱时间的 8-10%），修复规则是看着 21-40 号测试曲目里的失败例子定的，盲听仍待真人。

acceptance.text_zh: 她唱完到开始播放 <= 5 秒，全部在板子上算
acceptance.measured: 2.4 s board estimate, batch from her finished recording (1.13 s M4, 1.19 s E-core) on 20 s / 8 bars; streaming variant 0.33 s board estimate; measured while other builders loaded the Mac (load average ~30 on 10 cores); after the fix (not re-timed on the E-core): same 20 s vocadito excerpt on M4 under load, compute 0.57 s vs 0.79 s before (higher voices render fewer harmonics; the repair pass adds about 3 ms)

acceptance.text_zh: 不冲突 >= 95%，且平行五度/八度为零
acceptance.measured: AFTER FIX (audible.py: audible octave layout + repair vs her measured f0). (a) symbolic, 53 Bach test chorales, true soprano: no-clash 100.0% (Bach 73.8%), parallels 0/0 (Bach 68/19), output identical to before (0 of 53 chorales needed an octave shift), lowest A/T/B 55/48/40. (b) end to end on 40 vocadito real singers, scored against her ANNOTATED notes: no-clash 96.0% (before 96.0%; worst track 87.3%, 10 tracks below 95%), per voice A/T/B 98.0/98.1/97.7%; Duet sounding 91.6% of her singing time (silent 8.4%; before 91.4%); without the gate 89.9% (verifier method, before 88.7%); parallel 5ths/8ves vs her TRUE notes 0/0 (before 6/1 by the builder-eval copy, 5/0 by the verifier method), 0/0 on the verifier's time-grid version, 0/0 vs the transcription and among Duet's voices; verifier method (rendered gated stems): no-clash 96.5/96.0/95.9% at -6/-20/-30 dB (before 96.6/95.8/95.6%). Lowest Duet note over all 40 tracks A/T/B = MIDI 53/48/40 (before 34/26/16); Duet voices never cross (0 of 1483 slices). Transcription unchanged: note F1 0.59, onset F1 0.73.

acceptance.text_zh: 盲听：把 Duet 的和声与巴赫原作混在一起，听众接近一半的时候分不出来

Proxies on test: Duet chord = Bach's chord 33.5%, bass pc = Bach's 42.8%, same note as Bach A/T/B 33.7%/26.1%/29.6%; mean leap A/T/B Duet 1.3/1.6/2.8 vs Bach 1.6/2.0/3.3 st; held notes A Duet 46.7% vs Bach 38.4%; chord sets used Duet 86 vs Bach 164; hidden outer 5/8 Duet 16 vs Bach 15; key from melody 83.0%; shipped CRF alto same note as Bach 31.5% vs Duet alto 33.7%

how_to_run: .venv/bin/python futures/d1_record_harmonize/run.py IN.wav -o OUTDIR   (fixed pipeline by default; --no-fix gives the builder's original behaviour)
caveats_zh: 修复规则（她实测音高在两个半音之间时两个都当作可能、八度跳当作 YIN 泛音错误）是看着 21-40 号曲目里平行五度的失败例子定的，所以"真人零平行"不是留出测试集上的结果。
低声部声音（男声）时，Duet 三个声部整体放在巴赫的音区，她的旋律落在合唱中间或下面（像"旋律在次中音"的写法）：40 首里 14% 的段落她比 Duet 低音还低，听到的和弦转位会变；扒谱出八度/泛音错误时中音会被带到 MIDI 82。
真人录音的 >=95% 不冲突仍靠"音高闸门"：她实测音高和某个声部构成刺耳音程时把那个声部静音，Duet 只在她 91.6% 的演唱时间里有声音；不加闸门约 90%。40 首里 10 首单独低于 95%，最差 87.3%。
A1.1 只是板子估算（M4 能效核单线程 x2），没有在 Radxa 板子上实测；修复后没有重新在能效核上计时（M4 上同一段反而更快）。
修复时顺带改了一个 bug：产品流程(process)里闸门把调音偏差减了两次（|偏差| > 0.15 半音时），评测脚本没有这个问题；修复前的数字（--no-fix）保留原样。
扒谱(transcription)仍是主要误差来源：vocadito 上音符 F1 0.59，召回 0.50。
和弦与巴赫完全一致的比例只有 33.5%（测试集），声部比巴赫更少跳进、更多保持，所以盲听很可能听得出来。
